promotion_decision.analysis: HOLD: saved full-section backing and load-bearing assumptions do not describe this machined candidate. No MILP/Karamba rerun performed.
promotion_decision.reason: Clashes clear geometrically but local backing area falls 45.11%, one second moment falls 83.46%, and cladding face contact is removed locally. Physical fit plus competent notch/connection and load-path review must choose a defensible detail before rerun.
rerun_if_detail_is_accepted: Bind six explicit groove geometries and source machining operations.
Model reduced backing sections and revised cladding bearings/loads.
Keep brace/post bearings unless an explicitly justified redesign changes them.
Then rerun the affected structural cases and compare; no full allocation MILP is implied by these unchanged stock intervals.

controlled_change_decision.reason: Actual face membership and noncollinear terminal triangle pass. Existing R03 native and full-assembly certificate remain source-bound; no corrected analysis input is justified.
required_evidence: Fastener type/diameter/count, hole and assembly specification

Connection slip and rotational stiffness or a substantiated mechanical model
controlled_change_decision.next_revision_gate: A demonstrated physical-model discrepancy or specified/calibrated connection law may justify a controlled R04 comparison; missing physical data alone does not justify invented springs or another arbitrary native solve.

assumptions.connection_model: In-plane hinge with lateral cleat; two out-of-plane rotations restrained locally by ideal connector; NOT all joints rigid.

warnings: Preliminary elastic study, not strength/furniture/building-code or construction approval.
Anchored pinned bases, in-plane hinges and conceptual out-of-plane lateral cleats; fastener, anchor, plate and joint capacities unverified.
Roof cover 0.25 kPa, snow sensitivity 1.2 kPa and 卤wind/uplift 0.5 kPa are explicit study assumptions; not site-verified loads.
Connection offsets use massless finite rigid arms at factor 1000; no ground stabilization springs.

decision.reason: Numerical source geometry, releases, blank accounting and response equilibrium remain reproducible. Physical load transfer through lateral rafter/tie cleat, knot-free bearing, knee joinery and tension/shear anchors is not established. Develop separate physical details with verified stiffness/capacity; then reanalyse only if their releases, offsets, section removal, bracing, supports or loads change.

findings: Rafter/tie share a vertical side face; its nonzero contact area is not a horizontal gravity bearing or verified shear/hold-down joint.
Both eave beam halves touch the tie at the cap; F04_BEARING_N names only C3_BEAM_N_2. The unassigned N1 tie contact is geometry-only, not a second load path.
Knee ends and the three-way knee foot interpenetrate solid timber envelopes. Their notch/plate/fastener geometry and any extra material removal remain unresolved.
Cap has two coincident numerical offset elements to the two beam halves: documented implementation, not two physical cleats.
Base translations are fixed and all base rotations free. Zero reaction moment reflects that assumption; anchor layout, eccentricity, foundation and timber connection capacity are unavailable.
Saved wind deformation is absolute linear-elastic displacement at real nodes with display magnification removed. No code or serviceability limit is assumed.
